title: VibeCon SF Oct 24-25: Build, Ship, Win $10K + YC Interview
summary: VibeCon SF brings 200 builders together Oct 24-25, 2026. Grand prize: direct Y Combinator interview plus $10,000. Applications close Oct 15.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- VibeCon SF runs October 24-25, 2026, bringing 200 builders together for a two-day product sprint.
- Grand prize includes a direct Y Combinator interview and $10,000 cash for the winning team.
- Applications close Thursday, October 15, 2026, with the event powered by MongoDB and hosted by Emergent.


VibeCon SF returns to San Francisco for a high-stakes, two-day product-building sprint on October 24-25, 2026. Hosted by Emergent and powered by MongoDB, the event brings together 200 builders, founders, and engineers to ship a working product from scratch in 48 hours. The grand prize: a direct interview with Y Combinator and $10,000 in cash.


## Event Format and Structure


Participants form teams on-site and spend the weekend building, iterating, and shipping. Unlike traditional hackathons, VibeCon emphasizes real product viability over demos. Teams pitch live to a panel of venture capitalists, YC partners, and product leaders. The event runs continuously from Saturday morning through Sunday evening, with mentorship sessions, technical workshops, and late-night builder hours.


MongoDB provides cloud credits, database infrastructure support, and on-site engineers to help teams scale quickly. Emergent supplies the venue, catering, and community infrastructure to keep builders focused on execution.


## Prize Package and YC Interview


The winning team receives two high-value rewards: a $10,000 cash prize and a guaranteed interview slot with Y Combinator for the upcoming batch. This direct access bypasses the standard YC application funnel, offering a significant advantage for early-stage founders. Second and third place teams receive smaller cash prizes and extended mentorship from the sponsor network.


Past VibeCon winners have gone on to raise seed rounds, launch beta products within weeks, and secure follow-on funding from investors who attended the event.


## Application Deadline and Registration


Applications close on Thursday, October 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM Pacific. Prospective participants must submit a brief profile detailing their technical background, product interests, and team preferences. Solo applicants are matched with teams during the Friday evening kickoff. Registration is free, but acceptance is competitive due to venue capacity limits.


Officially launched on October 09, 2026, the event page went live with full details on the[VibeCon website](https://vibecon.com/) . Early applications are encouraged as spots fill quickly.


## What This Means


VibeCon SF 2026 represents a shift in how early-stage builders access capital and accelerator networks. By combining intense product development with direct investor access, the event compresses months of traditional fundraising timelines into a single weekend. For founders serious about shipping fast and getting in front of YC, this is a rare, high-leverage opportunity.
